# LESSON-0003
stamp: CONSOLIDATION-2026-10

## context
MONTHLY_IC 2026-10-03. GLOBAL AI-hardware/semi names were killed on the name's own near-term P&L or a loose "other"/valuation basis while the AI-capEx complex re-rated them from outside — the GLOBAL mirror of LESSON-0001 (IDX agri/CPO) one book over.

## belief
"Expensive on its own numbers" was judged from the name's own margin-fade arithmetic and EV/Kelly math — with the AI-capEx complex (hyperscaler capex guides, HBM scarcity, AI-compute re-rating) never carried inside the valuation frame. TSM's own thesis evidenced the re-rating (FY26 revenue +39%, GM 67.7%) yet the kill scored only the name's fade case; AMD's thesis held a dated 2027 DC-doubling guide and ~$725B→$1T hyperscaler capex, and the kill still scored only the name's own momentum/EV arithmetic.

## outcome
T-GLOBAL-TSM-001 killed 2026-09-16 "other" at 413.75 → +14.3% missed (the month's worst miss). T-GLOBAL-AMD-001 killed 2026-08-19 "other" at 484.39 → +30.9% missed (largest single ledger miss). Weak third: T-GLOBAL-TXN-002 (+7.9%, repeat kill governed by LESSON-0002). Counterexample respected: T-GLOBAL-QCOM-001 killed 2026-09-28 "base_rate" at 201.97 → −8.5%…

# LESSON-0002
stamp: CONSOLIDATION-2026-09

## context
MONTHLY_IC 2026-09-05. Four repeat kill pairs exist in the ledger: TXN, SMFG, ELSA, DSNG (two kills each). A second kill of the same name is not automatically a re-affirmation of the first kill's reason.

## belief
Re-killing a name whose thesis was previously killed re-affirms the first kill's dispositive reason, without re-testing whether that reason has gone stale.

## outcome
Repeat kills did not all earn. TXN: both kills avoided further loss (07-13 −17.0%, 08-19 −5.1%). DSNG: the second kill left +20.6% more. SMFG: the second kill left +9.8% more. ELSA: the second kill left +5.0% more.

## cause
`thesis_wrong` at the second decision — external re-rating (complex/macro) was not distinguished from name-specific deterioration. Where the first reason was a name/valuation call but the complex or macro had re-rated, the second kill repeated a now-stale reason.

## rule
Before a second kill of a previously killed name, re-test whether the first reason is now wrong (external re-rating vs name-specific deterioration); TXN-style repeats earn, DSNG-style repeats cost.

# LESSON-0001
stamp: CONSOLIDATION-2026-09

## context
MONTHLY_IC 2026-09-05. IDX agri/CPO names were killed while the commodity complex re-rated around them. War-premium tape intact (Brent ~95.9). Two of the three source kills carried valuation reason_tags; one carried process.

## belief
"Expensive on its own numbers" was judged from the name's own P&L / spot earnings, without carrying the commodity/energy complex and the macro tilt (CPO/agri complex, energy spot, war premium) inside the valuation frame.

## outcome
Kills avoided ~zero loss and left large gains: DSNG.JK 07-13 valuation +39.0%; TAPG.JK 08-19 valuation +21.9%; LSIP.JK 07-22 process +25.7%. The names re-rated with the complex after being killed.

## cause
`thesis_wrong` — valuation frame anchored to the name's own numbers while the commodity complex and macro regime were re-rating above them. The through-cycle marker was not re-set when the complex moved.

## rule
Value IDX agri/CPO names with the commodity-complex and macro tilt inside the valuation frame (spot, war premium), not the name's own P&L alone; a name re-rating with the complex is not "expensive on its own numbers."
